regional_replay.booking_rule: One destination per trip; the two grain lots can share a load. Same-month arrival; no route loss. Required trips are capacity bounds, not evidence of an available fleet.
regional_replay.stress: One booked southern departure is cancelled in January 2028 without same-month replacement. Current orders load before delayed lots; residual capacity serves the same destination.

scope: Regional depot receipts downstream of the national grain schedule. Feed and the 2026 predecessor retain their original schedules. Household delivery is outside this boundary.
